policy: 72 publishes target classifications only from this machine-readable ledger. A claim is evidence for the exact recorded commit and environment, not a transferable platform certification. Configured CI, source review, cross-compilation, and an unversioned local observation do not by themselves promote a target.

targets.label: Linux amd64
targets.classification: build and test target; runtime certification incomplete
targets.requiredEvidence: Real X11 hardware matrix with resize, DPI, minimize/restore, user close, texture upload, device loss/recovery, and clean shutdown

targets.label: Windows amd64
targets.requiredEvidence: Real Windows hardware matrix with the same lifecycle, input, and presentation checks

targets.label: macOS arm64/amd64
targets.requiredEvidence: Real macOS hardware matrix on each claimed architecture with the same lifecycle, input, and presentation checks

targets.label: Browser WebGPU
targets.classification: WebGPU-only experimental; not broadly deployable web support
targets.requiredEvidence: Secure-context Chromium, Firefox, and Safari matrix with rendering, input, resize/DPI, visibility, device loss/recovery, and shutdown
